Only import the complete JSON or QR code provided in person by the host operator. The app validates the CA, hostname and TLS pin, then binds pairing to the Noise public key, full account identity and this device’s signing key.
Rotating the host Noise key revokes previous pairing. Verify a new descriptor with the operator. Relay announcements or old connections cannot replace the host key automatically.

Rotate the device key for this host?

The app encrypts and saves the new key and recovery record, then submits one rotation over the connection authenticated by the old key. The old connection closes. If the reply is lost, the app verifies only the new key without retrying or reverting. The host public key does not change.
Save and rotate
Cancel
Remove local credentials only?

This does not revoke host access. The device might be registered even if pairing was not verified. After removal, you cannot verify or revoke using these credentials. Review the host settings and remove any remaining access there.
Remove locally only
Revoke pairing with this host?

The host will close local, relay and other encrypted connections for this paired device. Local credentials are deleted only after durable host revocation is confirmed. Relay account and lease permissions are unaffected.
Revoke pairing
TLS verification failed. Check hostname, administrator CA and public key fingerprint. No pairing code or credentials were sent on this connection.
Host identity did not match. The connection stopped without switching identity.
The host key or pairing version no longer matches. Ask the operator to revoke the old pairing and verify a new descriptor. A new public key is never accepted automatically.
The host, encryption protocol version or device encryption library is unsupported. Update and pair again. There is no unencrypted fallback.
Device key rotation is unverified, so native access is paused. Verify the saved new key or ask the host operator to revoke access.
Encrypted identity or account binding verification failed. The connection stopped without switching identity or falling back to plaintext.
This pairing grants independent local access only, with no relay device identity. Pair again after the operator explicitly grants access.
The host or relay rejected this credential. The recovery record is still saved. No alternate connection will bypass revocation.
The host denied access for this device. The app will not use relay to bypass it. Verify access or pair again.
The pairing code expired. Import a fresh descriptor from the host.
This runtime is already paired. Revoke or explicitly remove the old pairing first.
Finish recovering secure credentials before pairing.
Host access is still unverified. Verify and save, revoke on the host, or explicitly forget local recovery information only.
The saved host limit was reached. Remove an unused pairing first.
Could not connect to the host. Check the local network, address and whether the host is online. Writes are not retried automatically.
Secure storage is unavailable. Set a secure screen lock and unlock the device, then try again.
Pairing did not finish. Check the descriptor, device name and host status before retrying.
